It is hypothesised that EMPOWER-SMS- GP will
be effective in improving breast cancer survivors’ phys-
ical activity levels and secondary outcomes and will help
inform future implementation and scale-up of risk factor
management text message programmes into general prac-
tice for breast cancer survivors analysis across Australia.

SMS- GP (intervention; n=339) on participants’ health
outcomes compared with usual care alone (control; n=339)
